unresolved: Liquid milk values are per ml and stay unconverted; liquid samples were defatted by centrifugation before drying, which is not stated to be corrected for.
The text gives a Cr detection limit of 0.22 µg/ml, yet many liquid samples report Cr of 0.10-0.22 µg/ml.
Number of replicates or units behind each mean and range is not stated; sampling dates not stated.
Farm milk sites are near the Buriganga River and industrial disposal areas of Keraniganj; site_context set to market for the study overall, farm rows are farm-collected.
Several printed ranges are reversed or exclude their own means (flagged).
Powder-milk lead (about 2 µg/g) and mercury (1-5 µg/g) are very high for milk powder; EDXRF at these levels without a milk CRM is not validated.
